claim: AW25 / A-051 (analytics walk 2026-10-03), founder pick 2026-10-04 ~00:30Z, verbatim "Learn from the POS (Recommended)". Migration tables_learned_from_the_pos (cited by slug, ADR 0235) gives pos_checks a table_ref column holding the till's word, makes restaurant_tables.seats nullable and adds learned_at and hidden_at. A BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF raw, table_id, table_ref trigger on pos_checks (no WHEN clause: it reads the word out of raw first) resolves the word against the house's tables and learns a table when none answers. A DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED constraint trigger re-links earlier unlinked checks to a learned table at commit, and the re-link UPDATE fills only rows with table_id IS NULL, so a re-link never moves a link. The backfill copies the word out of raw for history. Evidence: supabase/tests/<ver>_tables_learned_from_the_pos_test.sql T1-T18 on the local Postgres harness (pgtest.sh lane, p4-scratch/sim-run/fixes/audits/tables-local-pg.txt). The check fails if the migration goes, if any of these clauses goes, or if a later migration drops the learning trigger without re-creating it. Mutation-checked 2026-10-04 against main 1aa4dcb8c (fails), by deleting the deferred trigger clause (fails) and by dropping raw from the trigger's column list (fails).

claim: AW25 and fix round 1 of lane tables (2026-10-04): the till's table word reaches pos_checks.table_ref through the database, not the gateway. pos_checks_find_or_learn_table (migration tables_learned_from_the_pos) sets table_ref from public.pos_table_ref_from_raw(source, raw) on every insert and on every update that writes raw: a word raw carries wins, a word that came from the old raw goes when the new raw names none, and a changed word re-resolves a link the statement did not set itself. pos-hub.service.ts therefore writes no table_ref (its row literal is main's), so a gateway deployed before the migration still stores every check, and the gateway already running learns tables as soon as the migration applies. Clover gives no word (pos_table_ref_from_raw returns NULL for it: its order type is a channel, founder AW24, verbatim "Own row, POS field (Recommended)"). Evidence: SQL test T17-T18 (six mutations of the trigger each fail one of them, 2026-10-04) and tables-learned-from-the-pos.spec.ts 'names no table_ref'. Mutation-checked 2026-10-04: fails on main 1aa4dcb8c, when the insert's read from raw is removed, and when the gateway's table_ref write is put back.
